name: useSpatialAudio
summary: Android Spatializer status, binaural rendering, and dynamic head tracking telemetry.
plain: Queries Android's Spatializer audio subsystem (API 32+). Detects whether spatial audio processing is active for the current output routing, whether binaural / transaural mode is enabled, and whether dynamic head tracking sensors (such as Pixel Buds Pro) are actively tracking.
description: Backed by android.media.Spatializer from the platform AudioManager. Queries audio DSP spatialization effects and checks whether the dynamic head tracker sensor is physically reporting. Nothing is simulated: reads directly from the audio HAL and reports source: 'hardware' on genuine devices.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether the platform supports the Android Spatializer API (API 32+).

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Whether spatial audio processing is available for the current audio routing path (e.g. A2DP headphones vs earpiece).

returns.name: isEnabled
returns.desc: Whether spatial audio is enabled in user system sound settings.

returns.name: hasHeadTracker
returns.desc: Whether a dynamic head tracker sensor (e.g. Pixel Buds Pro) is currently paired and reporting orientation.

returns.name: headTrackingMode
returns.desc: Active head tracking coordinate mode reported by the audio HAL.

returns.name: immersiveAudioLevel
returns.desc: Level of immersive spatialization applied by the audio DSP (0: none, 1: multichannel, 2: other).

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Latest error message if the Spatializer query failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the readings came from. Genuine hardware reports 'hardware', unsupported platforms report 'unavailable'.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Manually re-reads spatial audio status from the system AudioManager.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Manually re-reads spatial audio status from the system AudioManager.
